name: StreamHazard
title: One Health hazards arising from urban streams
description: Hazards whose short-term risk Tributary forecasts for people living near an urban stream reach.

concept.definition: Campylobacter, Cryptosporidium, Giardia, pathogenic E. coli and similar, typically after sewer overflow.
Toxins from harmful cyanobacterial blooms in warm, slow, nutrient-rich water.
Culex-borne arboviruses such as West Nile virus breeding in stream margins and pools.
